definitions: To entice or try to entice (someone) to do something, especially something morally wrong or unwise.
To be an attractive option for (someone); to make (someone) want to do something.
To provoke (a person or animal) to do something by offering something desirable.
examples: The offer of a free holiday tempted her.
Don't tempt fate by walking on the thin ice.
The smell of freshly baked bread tempted him.
